scripts.build: npm run build -w @artlyrics/shared && npm run build -w @artlyrics/api && npm run build -w @artlyrics/web
scripts.dev:db: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d db
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @artlyrics/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @artlyrics/api" "npm run dev -w @artlyrics/web"
